name: n8n-nodes-formaloo
description: Formaloo Trigger and Action nodes for n8n

scripts.build: npx rimraf dist && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: find nodes -name '*.svg' -o -name '*.png' -o -name '*.json' | xargs -I {} cp {} dist/{} 2>/dev/null || true && find credentials -name '*.svg' -o -name '*.png' | xargs -I {} cp {} dist/{} 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.start: npm run build && N8N_CUSTOM_EXTENSIONS=$(pwd) npx n8n start
